en: Select exactly one primary climate.* device assigned to this HA room. It supplies native capabilities; manual OFF or unsupported modes cannot be auto-restarted.
Independent fresh temperature sensor (°C or °F) in the same room; stale readings stop target changes. Avoid using an unrelated outdoor or thermostat estimate.
People or device trackers for home/away status. Absence is considered only with explicit, fresh evidence; unknown trackers are treated conservatively.
Optional same-room heat-only radiator or heating-zone climate.* entity. It must actually support HEAT; it never receives cooling commands.
Optional same-room air conditioner or cooling heat-pump climate.* entity. It must support COOL; manual OFF is respected.
Optional climate.* device with real native DRY. DRY-only devices provide humidity advice without fabricated temperature setpoints; automatic mode control is separately commissioned.
Optional climate.* device exposing FAN_ONLY. Do not assume an arbitrary air conditioner can safely switch to fan mode.
Optional HA humidifier.* adding moisture. Select only a matching same-room device; automatic setpoint/power changes need separate authorization.
Optional HA dehumidifier.* removing moisture. Compressor-equipped units need independent frost, tank and cycle protections.
Optional same-room fan.* extracting air, driven by verified CO₂/ventilation demand. Merely selecting the entity does not power it on.
Optional same-room fan.* used as air purifier for measured PM2.5. Filtration capability must be real; plain ventilation is not HEPA purification.
Select one fresh independent same-room RH sensor (%). Humidity controls hold rather than guess when this measurement is missing.
True same-room CO₂ sensor in ppm, preferably verified NDIR, used for demand-based extraction. eCO₂ from VOC is not equivalent.
Same-room PM2.5 µg/m³ sensor used for filtration control. Missing or unsupported data cannot start a purifier.
Select actual person/device tracker entities for home/away evidence. Unknown trackers do not prove everyone has left.
Select a numerical pollen-index sensor provided by Home Assistant. Country- and provider-specific indices are not automatically comparable.
Select one real outdoor AQI sensor to assign its provider's published scale; ordinary pollutant concentration sensors use their own units instead.
Choose the Home Assistant area whose devices you want to review. Device discovery is for inventory and does not enable any automation.
Choose exactly one monitored device to adjust its capabilities, consent, occupancy and setpoint rules. Other room devices remain unchanged.
Select a real fresh independent temperature sensor in the same area. Missing data holds thermostat setpoint changes.
Select a real relative-humidity sensor (%) in the same area to inform humidification/dehumidification. Stale data cannot drive a power change.
Choose an actual CO₂ ppm source for extraction decisions, ideally verified NDIR. TVOC-derived eCO₂ is not equivalent to measured CO₂.
Choose a real PM2.5 µg/m³ sensor in this room for purifier decisions. Unsupported indices or estimated particle levels are not accepted.
